title: Chat decides: can our village survive? 🔴 LIVE pixel colony game
description:
🏡 Type anything in the LIVE CHAT and you move into the village: your own house, your own villager, your name on screen. 24/7!

HOW TO PLAY
1. Every 30 seconds the village faces a new event (storms, wolves, traders, fires …).
2. Type 1, 2 or 3 to vote. The chat decides, and you see what happens right away.
3. Alone in the stream? Then YOU decide, and fast.
4. !fish  !chop  !build = your own action in the village
5. !house = see your home, rank and daily streak

🐉 Daily dragon attack at 8 PM UK: be there and defend your house (+10 points).
🏰 Weekly goal: build the tower together, floor by floor.
⭐ Ranks: Settler → Farmer → Builder → Elder. Come back every day to keep your streak.

🎱 Our other live games: Country Marble Race and Guess the Word – youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/streams

🎵 Original music made for this channel (AI-generated). Pixel art: Kenney (CC0).
Be kind in the chat – names are shown on stream.
